mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zqzt_grp_group_info( GRP_ID, GRP_NAME, GRP_CODE, HQ_GRP_CODE, CUST_ID, GRP_LEVEL, GRP_STATUS, AREA_ID, COUNTY_ID, COUNTY_ID2, GRID_ID, INDUSTRY_MAJOR_KIND, INDUSTRY_SUB_KIND, INDUSTRY_DETAIL_KIND, BUSI_TYPE, GRP_CUST_TYPE, GRP_EXPAND_TYPE, GRP_BUSI_DEPT_TYPE, PROVINCE_NEWOLD_TYPE, MANAGER_ID, GRP_CREATOR, GRP_CREATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME ) SELECT GRP_ID, GRP_NAME, GRP_CODE, ZB_CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTID, GRP_LEVEL, GRP_STAT, AREAID, COUNTYID, COUNTYID2, GRID_ID, INDUSTRY_MAJOR_KIND, INDUSTRY_SUB_KIND, INDUSTRY_DETAIL_KIND, BUSI_TYPE, GRP_CUST_TYPE1, GRP_EXPAND_TYPE, GRP_BUSI_DEPT_TYPE, PROVINCE_NEWOLD_TYPE, MANAGERID, CREATOR, CREATE_TIME, NOW(), NOW() FROM grp_group_info WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.select: select t1.grp_id, t2.cust_name as grp_name, t1.grp_code, t1.hq_grp_code, t1.cust_id, case when t2.cust_state = '2' then 'Y' else t1.grp_level end grp_level, case when t2.cust_state = '0' then '03' when t2.cust_state = '1' then '02' when t2.cust_state = '2' then '05' when t2.cust_state = '3' then '06' when t2.cust_state = '4' then '04' end grp_status, t1.area_id, t2.b_city_code as county_id, t1.county_id2, t1.grid_id, t2.first_calling_type_code as industry_major_kind, CONCAT(t2.second_calling_type_code, 'AA') as industry_sub_kind, t2.third_calling_type_code as industry_detail_kind, t1.busi_type, case when t2.cust_class_type = '1' then '600' when t2.cust_class_type = '2' then '500' when t2.cust_class_type = '3' then '400' else t2.cust_class_type end as grp_cust_type, t1.grp_expand_type, t1.grp_busi_dept_type, t1.province_newold_type, t1.manager_id, t1.grp_creator, t1.grp_create_time, t1.prov_manager_emp_id, t1.prov_manager_oauser, t1.prov_manager_name, t1.city_manager_emp_id, t1.city_manager_oauser, t1.city_manager_name, t1.county_manager_emp_id, t1.county_manager_oauser, t1.county_manager_name, t1.create_time, t1.update_time from zqzt_grp_group_info t1 inner join tf_f_cust_group_d t2 on t1.hq_grp_code = t2.group_id where date(t2.update_date) = date(#{createDate}) and date(t2.create_date) <> date(#{createDate}) and ( (t2.cust_state = '2' and t1.grp_level <> 'Y') or (t2.cust_state in ('0', '1', '2', '3', '4') and coalesce(t1.grp_status, '') <> case when t2.cust_state = '0' then '03' when t2.cust_state = '1' then '02' when t2.cust_state = '2' then '05' when t2.cust_state = '3' then '06' when t2.cust_state = '4' then '04' end ) or coalesce(t1.county_id, '') <> coalesce(t2.b_city_code, '') or coalesce(t1.grp_cust_type, '') <> coalesce( case when t2.cust_class_type = '1' then '600' when t2.cust_class_type = '2' then '500' when t2.cust_class_type = '3' then '400' else t2.cust_class_type end, '') or coalesce(t1.grp_name, '') <> coalesce(t2.cust_name, '') or coalesce(t1.industry_major_kind, '') <> coalesce(t2.first_calling_type_code, '') or coalesce(t1.industry_sub_kind, '') <> coalesce(CONCAT(t2.second_calling_type_code, 'AA'), '') or coalesce(t1.industry_detail_kind, '') <> coalesce(t2.third_calling_type_code, '') )
mapper.sql: select GRP_ID, GRP_NAME, GRP_CODE, HQ_GRP_CODE, CUST_ID, GRP_LEVEL, GRP_STATUS, AREA_ID, COUNTY_ID, COUNTY_ID2, GRID_ID, INDUSTRY_MAJOR_KIND, INDUSTRY_SUB_KIND, INDUSTRY_DETAIL_KIND, BUSI_TYPE, GRP_CUST_TYPE, GRP_EXPAND_TYPE, GRP_BUSI_DEPT_TYPE, PROVINCE_NEWOLD_TYPE, MANAGER_ID, GRP_CREATOR, GRP_CREATE_TIME, PROV_MANAGER_EMP_ID, PROV_MANAGER_OAUSER, PROV_MANAGER_NAME, CITY_MANAGER_EMP_ID, CITY_MANAGER_OAUSER, CITY_MANAGER_NAME, COUNTY_MANAGER_EMP_ID, COUNTY_MANAGER_OAUSER, COUNTY_MANAGER_NAME, CUST_MANAGER_EMP_ID, CUST_MANAGER_OAUSER, CUST_MANAGER_NAME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME from zqzt_grp_group_info
